svg.aria-label: A generic compute satellite of the 250-kilowatt class, as a museum model on its rotation fixture on a plinth. A flat-pack bus is held by trunnions in two uprights with a handwheel and clamp jaws. Two solar wings on hinged booms carry gridded cell panels; two radiator panels stand edge-on to the Sun behind the compute module, fed by supply and return coolant pipes from its sides. The compute module's access panel is swung open on its hinge to show a stack of six accelerator trays, the one lit part. Laser terminals, Hall thrusters and a star tracker sit on the bus.
